scenes.text: Last time, something knocked on your airlock, wearing your name. You kept the door sealed.
The figure doesn't knock again. It just floats there, one hand on the glass, watching you. For an hour. Then two.
Then it lets go, and crawls along the hull. Out of sight.
You lock every hatch on the ship. You tell yourself you imagined it. Seven months alone will do that to a mind.
But you check on the crew anyway. Four pods. Four sleepers. Then you reach the fifth pod. Yours. It should be empty.
You wipe away the frost. There's a man inside. He has your face. The same scar on the chin. The same grey in his hair.
The ship's log says pilot Voss never woke up. Not once in two hundred twelve days. So who are you?
Then the pod begins its wake-up cycle. Sixty seconds. The glass starts to clear. His fingers twitch.
And the radio screams. It's the voice from outside. Don't let it wake up. That thing is not me.

choice.narration: Do you abort the wake-up? Or let the pod open?
choice.question: WHAT DO YOU DO?
